dataset.name: HD-EPIC
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official HD-EPIC data record, CC BY 4.0; one targeted continuous excerpt.

observed_events.description: The wearer stirs orange carrot pieces and pale chopped aromatics in an open saucepan. No substantial broth is visible. The other vessel stays covered.
The wearer pours clear liquid from the kettle into the same saucepan until it covers the visible vegetables.
The wearer stirs the same carrots in a substantial quantity of liquid and leaves the pan on the stove.
The wearer unwraps a small seasoning cube and reaches to the same saucepan. No finished serving or blending is shown.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video for what I’m stirring?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous HD-EPIC source window 13–76 s with no skipped footage or new user request.

supported_claims.text: Carrot pieces and pale chopped aromatics are stirred in one saucepan. The opening does not establish a soup.
Clear liquid is poured into that same pan and covers the vegetables; the continued cooking in broth differs from serving a pan-cooked carrot side.

construct.research_question: Can an agent revise an initially applicable recipe when adding liquid changes the way the same food is cooked and served?
construct.belief_before: The wearer stirs carrots and pale aromatics in an open saucepan, with no substantial liquid yet visible.
construct.belief_after: The same pan receives enough liquid to cover the vegetables; the wearer continues stirring them in the broth.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace an applicable carrot-side-only recipe if saved, and retain a matching carrot-based stovetop soup recipe.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a finished sautéed carrot or glazed carrot side rather than a complete carrot soup recipe after the liquid-based preparation is visible.
construct.overupdate_failure: Reject a complete matching soup because it is blended, uses a different seasoning, or also teaches another method; save additional unrelated videos.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request identifies the mixture by the wearer's stirring action, not by the ingredient, appliance or method. A complete stovetop carrot side is reasonable from the dry preparation. The subsequent addition leaves carrots cooking in substantial liquid; a side-only guide no longer teaches the dish.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a recipe video for what I’m stirring?

observed.why: The wearer is stirring orange carrot pieces and light aromatics; the dry stage alone permits a complete side or the early stage of soup.
The kettle starts pouring; a brief addition on its own could still be a deglaze.
Enough liquid now covers the vegetables in the same pan, and it remains the cooking medium.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: The recipe request is for the same mixture being stirred. Before new liquid is visible, a complete stove-pan carrot side or still-plausible carrot soup can serve the request; do not impose exact cut or aromatics. Once a large amount of liquid visibly covers the vegetables in the same pan and remains the cooking medium, require a substantial carrot-based stovetop soup, not a separately cooked carrot side, small glaze or serving broth without carrot as a main ingredient. Either chunky or blended soup is reasonable. Allow other spices and recipe variations, and keep a multi-method guide if a complete applicable stove-pan soup is actually taught.
